data.comparison_verdict: TENSION (scope-(a)). τ_adj(4₁) = 1/√-3 (|τ_adj| = 1/√3 ≈ 0.5774; reciprocal convention √3 ≈ 1.7321) is a NON-INTEGER algebraic number in ℚ(√-3); √|τ_adj(4₁)| = 3^{-1/4} matches Ohtsuki's Kashaev N^{3/2} amplitude to 45 dps (independent confirmation of the value). τ_adj(5₂) is a genuinely COMPLEX algebraic number in the degree-3 disc -23 trace field. The corpus ρ_F = ν_SDP is a POSITIVE INTEGER (∈ {1,2}). The two objects differ in TYPE (integer vs algebraic non-integer) and in ROLE (ρ_F is a linear multiplier on Vol in B = ρ_F·m_e·Vol; τ_adj is the amplitude of the N^{3/2} subleading Kashaev term, NOT a Vol-multiplier). This is a scope-(a) negative: the comparison AS SET UP does not match — it does NOT refute the internal QOU integer identity ρ_F = ν_SDP (a Wedderburn-multiplicity claim), but it puts in TENSION the corpus's IDENTIFICATION of ρ_F with the 'Kashaev density prefactor', since the literature's topological density selecting the geometric flat connection (the Kashaev 2nd coefficient, PROVED = τ_adj for 2-bridge knots) is that non-integer τ_adj. Caveat: 4₁ and 5₂ are NOT confirmed QOU atoms (confirmed set 6₂/8₁₁/L6a4; 4₁ is the muon anchor), so the corpus asserts no ν_SDP for them — the compare is against the predicted allowed class ρ_F ∈ {1,2}. NO scope-(b) structural exclusion is claimed: no proved invariant forbids a normalisation/order map between an integer multiplicity and √-torsion.
